newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Souza Cruz started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Souza Cruz started.

text.p: Bear, Stearns & Co Inc said on Monday it initiated coverage of Brazilian cigarette and tobacco company Souza Cruz with an attractive rating.

-- "Given the company's dominant market position, strong balance sheet, consistent profits reporting and attractive yield, we felt Souza Cruz should be considered a core holding in a Brazilian equity portfolio," analyst Christina Sobral said in a research note.
-- In U.S. dollars, her 1997 earnings estimate was $0.95 per share and her 1998 estimate was $1.15 per share.
-- Improving gross and operating margins, following a recent restructuring, should boost profits, she said.
